camel_example: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/models --region cn-hangzhou --Order DESC --Origin ModelScope --Task 'text-classification' --ModelName Sentiment_analysis --PageSize 10 --Query nlp --SortBy GmtCreateTime --WorkspaceId 32400 --Label key1 --Conditions '[{"Operator":"LessThan","Column":"ParameterSize","Value":"3000"}]' --Provider pai --PageNumber 1 --ModelType Endpoint --Tag '[{"Value":"value1","Key":"key1"}]' --Domain nlp --Collections 'AI4D,QuickStart' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace list-models --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --order DESC --sort-by GmtCreateTime --workspace-id 32400 --model-name Sentiment_analysis --label key1 --provider pai --domain nlp --task text-classification --origin ModelScope --query nlp --model-type Endpoint --collections AI4D,QuickStart --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --conditions Operator=LessThan Column=ParameterSize Value=3000 --region cn-hangzhou
